name: Survey tile in Scorpius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Scorpius, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 3 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-08-06, at wavelengths from 1.14 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
